title: Structural baseline ladder
hypothesis: Continuing the smooth structural coordinate U = TVT + Z with conservative low-order trends will materially beat direct last-known-TVT continuation while remaining stable on repeated whole-well folds and long hidden suffixes.

legal_inputs: frozen E001 fold assignments for reporting only
candidates: constant U continuation anchored at the final visible row
bounded cubic-Hermite U continuation whose slope damps to zero
diagnostics: visible-prefix sign verification for TVT+Z versus TVT-Z
residual correlations against last-known and constant-U paths
design.promotion: Promote the best legal candidate only if pooled RMSE improves at least 0.15, at least 20/25 frozen fold cells improve, p90 well RMSE worsens by no more than 0.25, worst-5% SSE share rises by no more than 0.02, the long-hidden stress slice improves, controls pass, and runtime remains below 20 minutes.
